# Fresh Pantry — Discover Everyday Deliciousness

## Overview

Build a single-page e-commerce landing site for **Fresh Pantry**, a neighborhood grocery brand that celebrates unique, high-quality food products at great prices. The audience is health-conscious grocery shoppers who love discovering new finds — think the excitement of wandering a well-curated store aisle, translated to the web. The tone should feel **warm, playful, and modern** — approachable but polished, never corporate or sterile.

## Visual & Style Direction

- **Color palette:** Think fresh greens, warm cream/off-white backgrounds, pops of sunny yellow or terracotta for accents. Avoid harsh neons or overly dark tones.
- **Typography:** A friendly rounded sans-serif for headings (something like Nunito or Poppins) paired with a clean body font. Keep it legible and inviting.
- **Imagery mood:** Bright, natural-light food photography vibes. Use placeholder images that suggest colorful produce, pantry staples, and cozy store interiors.
- **Layout:** Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, subtle shadows — the whole page should feel like a pleasant stroll through a sunlit market.

## Key Priorities

1. **The featured products carousel** is the centerpiece interaction — make sure the left/right navigation feels smooth and the product cards (with images, names, and prices) are visually appealing and easy to scan.
2. **The store locator** should feel functional and responsive: a zip code input with a search button that reveals mock store results. This drives the core business goal of in-store visits.
3. **Brand highlights stats** (500+ stores, 4,000+ products, etc.) should be presented as an eye-catching banner — use bold numbers with supporting labels to build credibility at a glance.
4. **Category hover effects** should feel delightful but not distracting — a gentle scale-up with an overlay is the target.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section list, all interaction specs, data display requirements, and navigation structure.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

We curate unique, hard-to-find food products alongside everyday essentials, all at prices that make you smile. Our mission is simple: make great food accessible to everyone, with a warm, welcoming shopping experience that feels like home.

  { name: 'Everything But The Bagel Seasoning', desc: 'A savory blend of sesame, garlic, onion & poppy seeds', price: '$2.49', icon: '🧂', bg: '#F0EDE5' },

  { name: 'Unexpected Cheddar Cheese', desc: 'Aged cheddar with crystalline crunch and complex flavor', price: '$3.99', icon: '🧀', bg: '#FFF3CD' },
  { name: 'Spicy Mango Lemonade', desc: 'Tropical mango with a kick of chili and fresh lemon', price: '$2.79', icon: '🥭', bg: '#FFF9C4' },
  { name: 'Truffle Marcona Almonds', desc: 'Roasted marcona almonds dusted with black truffle salt', price: '$4.49', icon: '🥜', bg: '#E8D5B7' }

const seasonal = [
  { name: 'Watermelon Mint Sparkling Water', desc: 'Refreshing fizz with real watermelon essence and a hint of mint', price: '$1.99', icon: '🍉' },
  { name: 'Grilled Peach & Burrata Salad Kit', desc: 'Everything you need for a summer salad in one box', price: '$5.49', icon: '🍑' },
  { name: 'Coconut Cold Brew Concentrate', desc: 'Smooth, creamy cold brew with natural coconut flavor', price: '$6.99', icon: '🥥' },
  { name: 'Mango Sticky Rice Spring Rolls', desc: 'A sweet twist on a classic, ready in minutes', price: '$3.99', icon: '🥭' }
];

const categories = [
  { name: 'Snacks & Sweets', desc: 'Chips, cookies, trail mixes, and guilty pleasures', icon: '🍪', bg: '#FFF3E0' },
  { name: 'Fresh Produce', desc: 'Seasonal fruits, vegetables, and organic picks', icon: '🥬', bg: '#E8F5E9' },
  { name: 'Frozen Favorites', desc: 'Meals, appetizers, and desserts straight from the freezer', icon: '🍦', bg: '#E3F2FD' },
  { name: 'Beverages', desc: 'Juices, sparkling waters, coffees, and teas', icon: '🧃', bg: '#FCE4EC' },
  { name: 'Dairy & Cheese', desc: 'Artisan cheeses, yogurts, milk, and plant-based alternatives', icon: '🧀', bg: '#FFF8E1' }
];

];

    <div class="product-body">
      <div class="product-name">${p.name}</div>
      <div class="product-desc">${p.desc}</div>
      <div class="product-price">${p.price}</div>
    </div>`;
  track.appendChild(card);
});

// ── Carousel Navigation ────────────────
let scrollPos = 0;
const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');

function updateCarouselButtons() {
  const maxScroll = track.scrollWidth - track.parentElement.clientWidth;
  prevBtn.disabled = scrollPos <= 0;
  nextBtn.disabled = scrollPos >= maxScroll - 2;
}

function slideCarousel(direction) {
  const cardWidth = track.children[0].offsetWidth + 20;
  const viewWidth = track.parentElement.clientWidth;
  const maxScroll = track.scrollWidth - viewWidth;
  scrollPos += direction * cardWidth * Math.floor(viewWidth / cardWidth);
  scrollPos = Math.max(0, Math.min(scrollPos, maxScroll));
  track.style.transform = `translateX(-${scrollPos}px)`;
  updateCarouselButtons();
}

prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => slideCarousel(-1));
nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => slideCarousel(1));
window.addEventListener('resize', () => { scrollPos = 0; track.style.transform = 'translateX(0)'; updateCarouselButtons(); });
updateCarouselButtons();

// Touch/drag support for carousel
let isDown = false, startX, startScroll;
track.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { isDown = true; startX = e.pageX; startScroll = scrollPos; track.style.cursor = 'grabbing'; });
track.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isDown = false; track.style.cursor = 'grab'; });
track.addEventListener('mouseup', e => {
  if (!isDown) return;
  isDown = false; track.style.cursor = 'grab';
  const diff = startX - e.pageX;
  if (Math.abs(diff) > 30) slideCarousel(diff > 0 ? 1 : -1);
});

    <div class="cat-overlay"><div><h3>${c.name}</h3><span>${c.desc}</span></div></div>`;

});

// ── Store Locator ──────────────────────
const locatorForm = document.getElementById('locatorForm');
const storeResults = document.getElementById('storeResults');
locatorForm.addEventListener('submit', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const zip = document.getElementById('locatorInput').value.trim();
  if (!zip) return;
  storeResults.innerHTML = stores.map(s => `
    <div class="store-card">
      <div>
        <div class="store-name">${s.name}</div>
        <div class="store-addr">${s.addr}</div>
        <div class="store-hours">${s.hours}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="store-dist">${s.dist} <small>away</small></div>
    </div>`).join('');
  storeResults.classList.add('visible');
});

// ── Newsletter ─────────────────────────
const newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
const newsletterConfirm = document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm');
newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  newsletterForm.style.display = 'none';
  newsletterConfirm.style.display = 'block';
});

// ── Mobile Menu ────────────────────────
const menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
const navMenu = document.getElementById('navMenu');
menuToggle.addEventListener('click', () => navMenu.classList.toggle('open'));
navMenu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
  link.addEventListener('click', () => navMenu.classList.remove('open'));
});

// ── Stagger-reveal animation on scroll ──
const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
  });
}, { threshold: 0.1 });

document.querySelectorAll('.product-card, .seasonal-card, .cat-card, .stat-number').forEach(el => {
  el.style.opacity = '0';
  el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s ease';
  observer.observe(el);
});
</script>

});
